intended_object: The canonical order isomorphism between the lattice of submonoids of M and the lattice of submonoids of the opposite monoid Mᵐᵒᵖ, sending H to H.op (the same set viewed in Mᵐᵒᵖ). Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: The forward map is Submonoid.op, the preimage under unop, so the same underlying set; it is closed under the opposite multiplication because the original submonoid is closed under multiplication with the factors swapped. The inverse is Submonoid.unop, and the two maps are mutually inverse by rfl. Order is preserved and reflected by op_le_op_iff. This is exactly the canonical order isomorphism. It is stated for MulOneClass, the minimal setting in which submonoids exist, so it is not too narrow.
